description: Surface the shared engine through an operational Power App while keeping the calculation implementation independent and the standard-connector/file path usable.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/careops: maintained costing module and non-premium SharePoint-oriented delivery patterns.
Target Microsoft tenant/environment and authorised host owner: actual entitlements, identity, configuration and permitted-data scope.
completion_evidence: The baseline demonstrates input export, CLI execution and result import without a hidden premium connector, HTTP action, gateway, Dataverse or Copilot requirement.
Actual user/environment rights and target-host behaviour are recorded before deployment; a Standard badge is not treated as an entitlement decision.
Large payloads/results use immutable files; Lists hold identities, state and summaries, and incomplete results are visibly incomplete.
A worker handles idempotency, claiming, retry/cancellation and scoped access without bypassing service or licensing obligations.
An API or browser component uses the same qualified numerical implementation and does not duplicate Power Fx calculation rules.
Optional routes have separate capability status; their absence does not block the CLI or core release.
